D: A spell to make the world forget Peter Parker goes wrong and brings villains from other worlds.
P: Serve dessert when Peter walks into the coffee shop where MJ works.
S: Tomato and red lentil soup simmered with onion, garlic and cumin, blended smooth, served in mugs with grilled cheese fingers.

Thin, crackling Filipino spring rolls packed with pork, carrot and garlic, fried golden and served with sweet chilli and vinegar dipping sauces. Mix 400g pork mince with 1 grated carrot, 1 finely diced onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 egg, 1 tbsp soy sauce and pepper. Lay 20 spring roll wrappers out one at a time, put a thin line of filling along one edge, fold in the sides and roll tightly, sealing with water. Fry at 175C for 5 minutes until deep golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and vinegar mixed with garlic.
three Spider-Men together on the rooftop

Three smashed beef sliders each with melted cheddar, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft toasted buns, one for every Spider-Man. Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls. Smash each flat on a very hot greased pan, season and cook 90 seconds, flip, top with a quarter slice of cheddar and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp mustard, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and chopped pickles. Toast 12 slider buns. Fill each with sauce, a patty, pickles and finely diced onion. Serve three per person.
M: Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered in a slow tomato sauce, with garlic bread and parmesan.
the final battle at the Statue of Liberty

Grilled beef franks in toasted buns, smothered in beef chilli and melted cheddar, with diced onion, mustard and grilled corn on the side. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 400g crushed tomatoes and a drained can of kidney beans, and simmer 25 minutes. Grill 8 beef frankfurts for 6 minutes. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes and butter them. Toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 150g grated cheddar, diced onion and mustard.
W: the coffee shop where MJ works at the end

Yeasted dough proved, cut into rounds, fried at 175C until golden, filled with thick vanilla custard and rolled in caster sugar. Mix 350g flour, 7g yeast, 40g butter, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 180ml warm water and rest an hour. Cut rounds, prove 30 minutes and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe in 300ml thick custard and roll in 100g caster sugar.
K: MJ's coffee shop iced vanilla latte
Peter buying a coffee from MJ

Double shots of espresso poured over ice and cold milk with homemade vanilla syrup, topped with a thick, frothy cold foam. Simmer 100g caster sugar and 100ml water with 1 split vanilla pod for 3 minutes, then cool. Brew 8 shots of espresso, or 320ml very strong coffee, and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and 200ml cold milk to each, then pour over the coffee. Froth 150ml cold milk with 50ml cream until thick and spoon on top.
